manifest.description: Ingest `mix credo --format=json` output and propose machine-applicable edits via elixir_credo_fix_round. v1 fixers: UnusedAlias, UnusedImport (remove directive line). Everything else surfaces in unresolved_issues.
when_to_use: post-hygiene-refactor pass to apply mechanical Credo lints
standalone: clean up Credo warnings of the mechanical subset
anti_patterns: do not use for style-only Credo lints (formatting, line length) — use mix format instead
do not expect comprehensive Credo coverage — the v1 fix catalog is narrow

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-credo-fix-round.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_credo_fix_round", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"credo_json": "..."}).
2. Inspect fixable_issues + unresolved_issues.
3. Apply through bbox_refactor_run when chained.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<fixable count + unresolved count>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{credo_json}}
